crossRefs.note: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.
Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.
Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.
Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.
Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us…
But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.
looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved…
Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his…

parallels.note: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

translations.web: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”
translations.bsb: You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.”
translations.kjv: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.
translations.asv: Be ye also ready: for in an hour that ye think not the Son of man cometh.
